## Featured Case Studies

### 1. [GA4 Ecommerce Analytics & Purchase Prediction](ga4-ecommerce-prediction.qmd)

An end-to-end analysis using **Google BigQuery, SQL, Python, statistical testing (Chi-square/Cramér's V), and machine learning** to analyze ecommerce funnel drop-offs and predict future purchase conversion.

* **Key Outcome:** Logistic Regression achieved **0.888 ROC-AUC** for lead prioritization while eliminating target leakage through time-based feature splitting.

## Interactive Data Visualizations

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

data = {
    "Funnel Stage": ["View Item", "Add to Cart", "Begin Checkout", "Purchase"],
    "Events": [386068, 58543, 38757, 5692]
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))
ax.bar(df["Funnel Stage"], df["Events"], color="#2b5c8f")
ax.set_ylabel("Event Count")
ax.set_title("GA4 Ecommerce Conversion Funnel")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
